audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Diana/Diana/Diana. The page rendered two answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.why: Ahri's Orb of Deception is 970 range and returns for true damage; Diana's Q is 900 and she has no dash until level 3, so Ahri owns 1-5. Moonfall at 6 plus the Lunar Rush reset flips it.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Ahri, phases[4..6].side = Diana, with phases[0..3].why rewritten to describe Ahri winning those stages.

audit.why: Spikes are level 3 (Lunar Rush online, 22s at rank 1), level 6 Moonfall (100/90/80), first item, and the late window where a spent Spirit Rush (140/120/100) leaves Ahri with no exit. spikes[] already tracks this; breakdown.carry and breakdown.late were generic Diana boilerplate and were grounded onto Spirit Rush charges.
audit.corrected: breakdown.carry / breakdown.late rewritten around Ahri's Spirit Rush cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon said 'dash the silence' — Ahri has no silence in her kit. The decisive interaction (Charm 'instantly stopping movement abilities', i.e. it kills Lunar Rush mid-dash) was never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's Charm text explicitly stops movement abilities; that is the single interaction that decides whether Diana's E commit works. Charm is a flat 12s at every rank, Lunar Rush is 22/20/18/16/14, so the Charm gap is the only safe step-up window.
audit.corrected: Stated in winCon, phases[2].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d and loading: Charm stops Lunar Rush mid-flight; commit only in the 12s gap after it is thrown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldown numbers.
audit.corrected: Charm 12s flat, Fox-Fire 9s->5s, Pale Cascade 15s->9s, Moonfall 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Essence Theft healing was never mentioned; Grievous Wounds timing was absent.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'needs-antiheal' — Ahri heals off every 9 minions and off takedowns, so chip damage does not stick.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.mid with a named item (Oblivion Orb) rather than a placeholder.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Use Spirit Rush' in wants.foe[1] — false positive, Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R name per the kit. The real defect in that line was the doubled word 'reset ... reset'.
audit.corrected: Reworded to 'disengage after poking, then reset to shop'.

notes:
CHART: full-layer phases[].side was 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[0..6] already read Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Ahri/Diana/Diana/Diana (matching packet.levelChart). I moved the side values to agree with the existing win[] rows, so no paired win[N] edit was possible — a win[N] edit would have had before === after and been refused. This closes a cross-layer disagreement rather than creating one. phases[0..3].why were rewritten in the same proposal to match the Ahri verdict; phases[4..6].why already described Diana winning, so they were left alone. Ratings left untouched (5/10, 5/10, 5/10, 5/10, 6/10, 6/10, 6/10) — I could not ground a rating change from the kit.
REPORT CAP: the sweep allows at most two report[] rewrites, so I fixed report[0].t and report[3].t only. report[1].t still contains the false 'dash the silence' claim (Ahri has no silence), and report[4].t / report[9].t / report[11].t are still misgendered ('his'). Those four are flagged for a later pass — I did not exceed the two-entry limit.
SUSPECT NAME: packet flagged 'Use Spirit Rush' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong ability name. False positive — Spirit Rush is Ahri's real R. The genuine defect there was the repeated word 'reset', which I fixed.
ANTI-HEAL: missingInteractions needs-antiheal folded into breakdown.mid with a named item (Oblivion Orb), replacing a fully templated sentence.
